subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: Should this intermediate shadow-scanning slice be allowed to land before the later safety and performance PRs are merged?
rationale: Unit coverage cannot settle the real-history refresh-latency tradeoff, and the runtime replay currently describes the later full-stack implementation rather than this exact branch.

options.title: Land the reviewed stack together
options.body: Require exact-head proof, then merge the dependency chain without releasing an intermediate scanner state.

options.title: Accept intermediate overhead
options.body: Merge this PR separately and explicitly accept potentially long changed-input refreshes until the follow-up slices land.

options.title: Pause for consolidation
options.body: Keep this PR open until the safety and performance changes can be rebased or combined into a safer landing unit.

recommendation.title: Land the reviewed stack together
recommendation.body: Require exact-head proof, then merge the dependency chain without releasing an intermediate scanner state.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership makes this the best available route for the stack and availability decision.
